chunks: Have they not travelled in the land that they could have the heart to understand, and ears to hear? It is not the eyes alone that do not see, oblivious are the hearts within their breasts.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between physical sight and spiritual understanding in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the concept of 'Qalb' (heart) as the seat of intellectual and spiritual perception, distinguishing it from the physical senses. It underscores that true insight (basirah) requires the purification of the heart from spiritual blindness, a theme central to the journey of the soul in Islamic mysticism and jurisprudence.
